detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Research Synthesis: Chemical Heredity and Thresholds
detail.summary: This cycle completes revisions to notebooks for 'Chemical Memory to Heredity Transition' and 'Prebiotic Copying Fidelity and Error Thresholds', incorporating thermodynamic frameworks and stoichiometric conditions for autocatalytic network stability.

children.title: Experimental Distinctions Between Autocatalytic Memory and Template-Directed Heredity

detail.title: Experimental Distinctions Between Autocatalytic Memory and Template-Directed Heredity
detail.summary: Autocatalytic networks maintain history-dependent compositional states (memory) through non-equilibrium thermodynamic feedback. Algebraic conditions on stoichiometric matrices provide structural criteria for identifying subgraphs capable of sustaining these multistable attractors, distinct from template-directed replication.
detail.reason: Incorporating new stoichiometric conditions for autocatalytic subgraphs and thermodynamic emergence framework.

children.title: Compositional Heredity and Error Thresholds in Prebiotic Systems

detail.title: Compositional Heredity and Error Thresholds in Prebiotic Systems
detail.summary: Heritability and evolution can potentially precede the emergence of genetically encoded templates in non-equilibrium systems, driven by autocatalytic motifs. Informational stability is contingent upon copying fidelity maintaining composition across growth-division regimes.
detail.reason: Refining the connection between autocatalytic motifs and hereditable information transfer.
